## The Kafka Mesh Filter

The Apache Kafka mesh filter provides a facade for Apache Kafka clusters. It allows for processing of Produce (producer) and Fetch (consumer) requests sent by downstream clients. The `convertHeaders`/`LibRdKafkaUtils` logic exists because the mesh filter's producer side relies on librdkafka. As described in the design, an instance of a Kafka producer (RdKafka::Producer) is created per internal worker thread (--concurrency), with custom configuration for each upstream (e.g. acks, buffer size). The producer path is responsible for receiving and processing requests from producers, and sending received records to multiple upstream Kafka clusters.

The `convertHeaders` function ultimately builds an `RdKafka::Headers` object. According to the librdkafka reference, the `Headers` class supports operations to create a new instance of the Headers object, create one from a std::vector, and add a Header to the end of the list.
